phase3HarnessGateLimitations: Ground-truth readiness is derived from clip-level boolean flags; the API has no reviewer/media-hash provenance input.
A single clip-level GT flag is reused across scenario buckets rather than validating per-bucket/per-stream annotations.
The shuttle_false_positives scenario has no metric branch and can appear passed when a GT flag is true even though shuttle metrics are null.
evaluatorPreparation.thresholdParserCaveat: Phase3QualityThresholds.from_dict supplies defaults for falsy/missing values and can replace maxIdSwitchesPer10Min=0 with 2.0. Future runs must validate all ten finite threshold keys and construct Phase3QualityThresholds directly; compare serialized values with the approved record.

evaluatorPreparation.shuttleInputRequirement: Complete independently reviewed frame labels over the exact clip duration, contiguous clip-local frame indices from zero, and real model observations keyed by clip ID. The harness reports measurements but does not certify Phase 3 thresholds; compare outputs externally with approved thresholds. Do not run with omitted predictions and interpret empty-output metrics as a model result.
